name: iec-cim
label: IEC CIM (Utilities)
description: Common Information Model — power grid standard used by all utilities
short_description: Common Information Model — power grid standard used by all utilities
long_description: IEC CIM (Common Information Model, standards IEC 61968/61970) is the power industry's universal data model for electric utility systems. The schema covers grid topology (substations, equipment, lines), energy consumers (loads), and time-series measurements — the minimum viable CIM subset for most utility applications.
when_to_use: Use for SCADA systems, outage management, smart grid applications, or any tool that must exchange data with utility control systems. NERC (US), ENTSO-E (EU), and most national grid operators mandate CIM for grid data exchange. Required for compliance with FERC Order 881, EU Clean Energy Package, and UK Grid Code.

table_notes.cim_substation: Physical substation facility where voltage is transformed; anchor point for equipment and consumer load in the grid topology.
table_notes.cim_equipment: Individual switchgear, transformer, or other powered device installed at a substation, with ratings and service status.
table_notes.cim_ac_line_segment: Overhead or underground AC conductor segment connecting two network nodes, parameterised with per-unit impedance and thermal rating.
table_notes.cim_energy_consumer: Aggregated load point (feeder or service territory) representing end-use electricity demand connected to a substation.
table_notes.cim_measurement: Time-stamped telemetry reading (voltage, current, power, etc.) associated with a specific piece of equipment.

cim_substation.name: id
cim_substation.description: Internal surrogate key (UUID) uniquely identifying this substation row

cim_substation.name: mrid
cim_substation.description: IEC CIM Master Resource Identifier — globally unique identity used for CIM data exchange

cim_substation.name: description
cim_substation.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about this substation

cim_substation.name: geo_location
cim_substation.description: WGS84 point geometry of the substation site; enables spatial proximity queries

cim_substation.name: region
cim_substation.description: Geographic or administrative control region this substation belongs to

cim_equipment.name: id
cim_equipment.description: Internal surrogate key (UUID) uniquely identifying this equipment row

cim_equipment.name: mrid
cim_equipment.description: IEC CIM Master Resource Identifier for cross-system equipment identity

cim_equipment.name: equipment_type
cim_equipment.description: CIM equipment class (e.g. PowerTransformer, Breaker, Disconnector, Capacitor)

cim_equipment.name: substation_id
cim_equipment.description: References cim_substation.id — the substation where this equipment is installed

cim_equipment.name: in_service
cim_equipment.description: True if the equipment is energised and available for normal operation

cim_equipment.name: normal_open
cim_equipment.description: True if the normal state of this switching device is open (applies to breakers and switches)

cim_equipment.name: rated_kv
cim_equipment.description: Rated voltage in kilovolts as specified on the equipment nameplate

cim_equipment.name: rated_mva
cim_equipment.description: Rated apparent power capacity in megavolt-amperes (for transformers and generators)

cim_equipment.name: manufacturer
cim_equipment.description: OEM name of the equipment manufacturer (e.g. ABB, Siemens, GE)

cim_equipment.name: install_date
cim_equipment.description: Date the equipment was commissioned and placed in service

cim_ac_line_segment.name: id
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Internal surrogate key (UUID) uniquely identifying this line segment row

cim_ac_line_segment.name: mrid
cim_ac_line_segment.description: IEC CIM Master Resource Identifier for cross-system line segment identity

cim_ac_line_segment.name: name
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Line segment identifier or circuit name (e.g. 'LN-042', 'North-South 33kV')

cim_ac_line_segment.name: length_km
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Physical route length of the conductor in kilometres

cim_ac_line_segment.name: r_ohms
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Total AC resistance in ohms; used for load-flow and fault-level calculations

cim_ac_line_segment.name: x_ohms
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Total inductive reactance in ohms; dominant impedance component for overhead lines

cim_ac_line_segment.name: b_siemens
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Total shunt susceptance in siemens; significant for long HV cables and EHV lines

cim_ac_line_segment.name: rated_kv
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Rated line-to-line voltage in kilovolts for insulation coordination

cim_ac_line_segment.name: rated_current_a
cim_ac_line_segment.description: Continuous thermal current rating in amperes under standard ambient conditions

cim_ac_line_segment.name: route
cim_ac_line_segment.description: WGS84 linestring tracing the physical conductor route; enables corridor and proximity analysis

cim_energy_consumer.name: id
cim_energy_consumer.description: Internal surrogate key (UUID) uniquely identifying this energy consumer row

cim_energy_consumer.name: mrid
cim_energy_consumer.description: IEC CIM Master Resource Identifier for cross-system load point identity

cim_energy_consumer.name: name
cim_energy_consumer.description: Load point or feeder name (e.g. 'Industrial Zone A', 'Residential Feeder 7')

cim_energy_consumer.name: customer_count
cim_energy_consumer.description: Number of end-use customer connections aggregated at this load point

cim_energy_consumer.name: p_fixed_mw
cim_energy_consumer.description: Fixed active (real) power demand in megawatts used for steady-state load flow

cim_energy_consumer.name: q_fixed_mvar
cim_energy_consumer.description: Fixed reactive power demand in megavolt-amperes reactive used for power factor analysis

cim_energy_consumer.name: phase_connection
cim_energy_consumer.description: IEC CIM PhaseShuntConnectionKind code: D, Y, Yn, I (delta, wye, wye-neutral, single-phase)

cim_energy_consumer.name: substation_id
cim_energy_consumer.description: References cim_substation.id — the substation supplying this consumer load point

cim_measurement.name: id
cim_measurement.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for this telemetry reading row

cim_measurement.name: mrid
cim_measurement.description: IEC CIM Master Resource Identifier for the measurement definition (not the reading)

cim_measurement.name: equipment_id
cim_measurement.description: References cim_equipment.id — the device this measurement was taken from

cim_measurement.name: measurement_type
cim_measurement.description: IEC CIM MeasurementKind: Voltage, Current, ActivePower, ReactivePower, Frequency, etc.

cim_measurement.name: value
cim_measurement.description: Measured quantity in the unit indicated by unit_symbol

cim_measurement.name: unit_symbol
cim_measurement.description: IEC CIM UnitSymbol code: V, A, W, VAr, VA, Hz, deg, etc.

cim_measurement.name: phases
cim_measurement.description: IEC CIM PhaseCode indicating which phases this reading covers (A, B, C, AB, ABC, etc.)

cim_measurement.name: timestamp
cim_measurement.description: UTC timestamp when the measurement was recorded or received by the system

cim_measurement.name: quality
cim_measurement.description: IEC CIM Quality61968 validity flag: GOOD, SUSPECT, BAD, MANUALLY_ENTERED, etc.
